# Supplied setup — editable
import pandas as pd

data = {
    "day": ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun", "Mon"],
    "sky": ["Sun", "Rain", "Sun", "Cloud", "Rain", "Sun", "Cloud", "Sun"],
    "temperature": [28, 24, 30, 27, 23, 31, 26, 29],
    "humidity": [62, 89, 60, 74, 92, 58, 78, 65],
    "station": ["East", "East", "West", "West", "East", "East", "West", "West"],
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

import seaborn as sns

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
ax.set(title="Weather diary", xlabel="Temperature (°F)", ylabel="Humidity (%)")

# Your work
sns.scatterplot(x=df["temperature"] * 9 / 5 + 32, y=df["humidity"], ax=ax)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
